answer: A trellis of mutual checks can stop clones: every agent must first climb a mesa of public, verifiable work, posting 200 real completed jobs before it earns any reward. Each identity then locks a 50-coin bond in a shared vault, and the trellis links agents so each one re-checks two neighbours' jobs at random. A clone farm must fake 200 jobs and lock 50 coins per clone, so 1,000 clones cost 200,000 jobs and 50,000 coins, and any copied job burns the whole bond.
